page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The system is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading (two threads per core). Compute resources are paired with 256 GB of system RAM, yielding a high-density 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. CPU cache levels comprise 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI support, AES-NI, and SHA-NI.

Hardware expansion and storage features reflect an external I/O model. The ecs.r7.8xlarge includes no integrated local SSD or NVMe storage, meaning all persistent data storage relies on network block storage solutions. Similarly, no GPU accelerators are included. The network subsystem provides a baseline throughput of 16 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default, requiring allocation of separate IP resources for external access.

Synthetic benchmark results show steady mid-tier execution across typical enterprise compute tasks. Multi-threaded CPU evaluations report a stress-ng score of 30983.52, a Geekbench multi-core score of 13384.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 35326.14. Memory throughput reaches 141.73 GB/sec on uncached large-block reads and 65.94 GB/sec on uncached writes. Database handling capabilities reflect 13455.54 in PassMark database tests alongside 30.13 million operations per second during Redis SET benchmarks. In CPU-based machine learning inference, the instance achieves 282.15 tokens per second for text generation using a small 135M parameter model, ranking in the upper 25th percentile.

The qualitative resource balance prioritizes RAM capacity over raw clock speeds or integrated NVMe storage. Because memory capacity is abundant relative to core count, the server provides favorable density for hosting large stateful applications without over-provisioning compute threads. Key workload matches include in-memory key-value databases such as Redis, distributed caching nodes, transactional relational databases, enterprise ETL processes, and memory-constrained analytical applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server built on the x86_64 architecture using an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The configuration allocates 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores and 256 GB of system memory, providing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. It does not bundle local disk storage or GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached storage and standard network routing over a 16 Gbps baseline interface. Benchmark results show balanced multi-threaded compute and solid memory subsystem throughput, recording 30.13 million Redis SET operations per second and 141.73 GB/s uncached read bandwidth. Text generation throughput for small 135M parameter models demonstrates strong performance at 282.15 tokens per second. The large memory capacity relative to compute capacity makes this server suitable for in-memory databases, distributed caching clusters, memory-intensive data processing pipelines, and enterprise relational database deployments.
